name: gauge
description: Local Codex token usage, prompt-cache reuse and estimated credits in an embedded dashboard.

interface.longDescription: Read locally recorded Codex usage for the current chat. Compare whole-chat, latest-call and latest-prompt cache reuse, view recent history, and estimate credits by token type. Python 3.11+ and uv are required; the host must support MCP Apps. Local logs may be incomplete and estimates are not billed usage or remaining allowance.
